name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including content, client/project association, portal visibility and private communication drafts. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; every editor exit returns there with a contextual label and restores the originating row/card, while native browser Back restores the same URL state. Direct or untrusted origins safely fall back to the Documents root. The header reserves a non-shrinking actions column from 1024 px and moves actions below the title at 412×915 and 835×1195; a long title is capped at two lines, while portal visibility and a long client name share an independently truncating metadata row. Concurrent state episodes and their open duration appear below it, with history and normalized observations covered by admin-document-state-workflow. The document-level Acciones menu stays separate from the non-wrapping Cancelar/Guardar pair. Failed or rejected saves retain the notes draft, while issued collection accounts stay read-only and outside the generic state workflow. The Markdown clipboard toolbar, template-style preview and dual PDF download remain available.
